description: One job whole: what to do (steps), each item with its ref, words, picture addresses, poll options and the time it should go out, and its state. A photos job has one item per real place or thing: what it is, where, how many pictures wait for it and where Marsell already looked. A job's steps say which steps stay the owner's (on a Google Ads account: adding the payment method and pressing Connect Google Ads); leave those to them. Do the job in the owner's name as the steps say, then report it with homework_done.

job_id.description: The job's id from homework_list (hw- and 16 hex characters).

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
